prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a parking lot collision. The patient had 27 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1077; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: The patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot and was diagnosed with cervical whiplash. Imaging and examination findings clearly confirm the soft-tissue injury to the neck. The patient attended 27 visits over the course of care, consisting of manual therapy, targeted home exercise instruction, and periodic reassessment. Treatment followed a typical clinical progression, with visit frequency tapering as range of motion and pain levels improved. No prior injury to the cervical region is known from the patient's history or available records. Billing records reflect single, appropriate charges for each service without duplication. At this time, it is not yet clear whether the injury resulted from this collision, as the timing and mechanism require further review alongside the patient's full history. The patient was discharged to self-directed exercise with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
